summary: Ran the full harness setup flow against the fresh Express clone. The local harness installed and `harness doctor --json` returned an Envelope, the harnessability assessment produced grade B with Operate-Today B (76.7%) and Adaptability B (73.3%), the repo passed the abandonment gate, governance was hand-written with all eight BIO fields, a `boot` extension was scaffolded through `harness new` and verified loaded/runnable, and a retro record was scaffolded and filled through `harness record retro`.

retrospective.workedWell: The repo-local skills resolved cleanly, the local file install exposed `npx harness`, the add-extension path scaffolded a loadable boot verb quickly, and Express already had a strong local Mocha/Supertest proof lane that made the boot command straightforward.
retrospective.confusing: The shell did not expose `MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT`, `harness doctor --json` reported a source-checkout-style cli-build degradation inside an installed target repo, and one plain boot invocation initially errored even though `--json`, direct `npm test`, and later plain boot runs passed.
retrospective.magicWand: Ship a non-interactive `harness setup --json --repo <path>` orchestrator that delegates to the same child setup skills, emits step Envelopes, and includes a real `harness init` writer for the BIO governance doc.

coordination.notes: Single-shot run; no peer coordination channel was used.

difficulties.description: The shell did not expose MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT even though the run instructions required starting from it.
difficulties.mitigation: Used the literal project root from the execution context: ~/substrate/harness-engineering.
difficulties.workaround: Used the literal project root from the execution context.

difficulties.description: There is no shipped harness init writer, so the governance doc had to be hand-written from the BIO template.
difficulties.mitigation: Read the governance template and wrote .harness/engineering-harness.md with all eight BIO fields.
difficulties.workaround: Hand-wrote the governance doc as the recipe explicitly allows.

difficulties.description: npx harness doctor --json worked but reported cli-build degraded because it looked for harness/cli/dist inside the target clone.
difficulties.mitigation: Treated the working npx harness entrypoint plus loaded extension/record-type discovery as sufficient while preserving the degraded doctor status.
difficulties.workaround: Relied on command-specific verification (`harness help`, `harness boot`) instead of doctor being fully green.

difficulties.description: The first plain `npx harness boot` invocation returned error even though `npx harness boot --json` and direct `npm test` passed immediately afterward.
difficulties.mitigation: Re-ran the boot with --json, direct npm test, HARNESS_JSON=1, NO_COLOR=1, and plain mode; recorded bootRuns true only after a real passing boot.
difficulties.workaround: Used JSON and direct command verification to establish the boot exercised the repo and returned an honest ok Envelope.

difficulties.description: A duplicate final `npx harness boot --json` verification hung in Mocha after earlier successful boot verification.
difficulties.mitigation: Inspected the process tree and terminated only the specific stuck duplicate boot process IDs, keeping the earlier successful boot evidence.
difficulties.workaround: Killed PIDs 10988, 10955, and 10936 after confirming they belonged to the duplicate target-repo boot check.
